title: Epsilon-Hollow (Seal OS): an operating system whose state is topology on the 2-sphere
description: A bare-metal x86_64 microkernel research operating system, written Rust-first as a no_std kernel with minimal assembly (AP trampoline, CPU idle). No POSIX, no libc. Operating-system state is represented as topology on S-squared, and scheduling, memory, and device state are read through that geometric representation rather than through conventional table structures.
